description: Notify New Relic about app deployments (see https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/apm/new-relic-apm/maintenance/record-monitor-deployments/).

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: The value of app_name in the newrelic.yml file used by the application. One of app_name or application_id is required.

parameters.name: app_name_exact_match
parameters.description: If this flag is set to true then the application ID lookup by name would only work for an exact match. If set to false it returns the first result. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: application_id
parameters.description: The application ID found in the metadata of the application in APM. One of app_name or application_id is required.

parameters.name: changelog
parameters.description: A list of changes for this deployment.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Text annotation for the deployment - notes for you.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: A revision number (for example, git commit SHA).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: API token to place in the Api-Key header.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The name of the user/process that triggered this deployment.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Notify New Relic about an app deployment
  community.general.newrelic_deployment:
    token: AAAAAA
    app_name: myapp
    user: ansible deployment
    revision: '1.0'
